questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.topic: Developmental and Health: Building a Belief That Action Is Possible
questions.stem: In an architect's brief, a client believes they can complete a renovation despite setbacks; this belief is?

options.text: Self-efficacy, the belief that action is possible.
Outcome expectancy, that effort will pay off.
options.misconception: confuses belief in self with belief in outcome

options.text: Perceived severity, how serious barriers are.
Regression to the mean, scores drifting.

questions.explanation: Believing one can perform an action is self-efficacy. Outcome expectancy concerns whether the action leads to a result.
